Average scoring by phase of an innings

phase_summary.Rd

Summarises runs and wickets per over for each team, either by phase of the innings (powerplay, middle overs, death overs) or over by over, for one innings and a range of years.

Usage

phase_summary(overs, innings = 1, years = NULL, by = c("phase", "over"))

Arguments

overs

A data frame of per-over scoring, such as aus_pak_overs, with columns match_id, date, innings, batting_team, over, over_runs and over_wickets.

innings

Which innings to summarise: 1 (batting first) or 2 (chasing).

years

Optional vector of two years, c(first, last), to keep only matches starting in that range (inclusive). NULL keeps all matches.

by

Either "phase" (powerplay, overs 1 to 10; middle, 11 to 40; death, 41 onwards) or "over" (one row per over number).

Value

A data frame with one row per team and phase (or over), with columns batting_team, the grouping column (phase or over), matches (number of matches contributing), runs_per_over and wickets_per_over. It has zero rows if no matches fall in the chosen range.

Details

Averages only use overs that were actually bowled, so late overs can come from fewer matches when innings end early. Phases are defined by over number, including in matches shortened by rain. Check matches before reading much into a result.

Examples

# Average scoring by phase, first innings, all years
phase_summary(aus_pak_overs)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   batting_team phase            matches runs_per_over wickets_per_over
#>   <chr>        <fct>              <int>         <dbl>            <dbl>
#> 1 Australia    Powerplay (1-10)      31          5.15            0.106
#> 2 Australia    Middle (11-40)        31          4.89            0.144
#> 3 Australia    Death (41+)           28          7.38            0.358
#> 4 Pakistan     Powerplay (1-10)      14          3.9             0.143
#> 5 Pakistan     Middle (11-40)        14          4.66            0.131
#> 6 Pakistan     Death (41+)           13          5.49            0.395

# Chasing innings in a narrower range of years
phase_summary(aus_pak_overs, innings = 2, years = c(2010, 2020))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   batting_team phase            matches runs_per_over wickets_per_over
#>   <chr>        <fct>              <int>         <dbl>            <dbl>
#> 1 Australia    Powerplay (1-10)       9          5.16           0.122 
#> 2 Australia    Middle (11-40)         9          5.06           0.0871
#> 3 Australia    Death (41+)            8          6.59           0.131 
#> 4 Pakistan     Powerplay (1-10)      15          4.58           0.127 
#> 5 Pakistan     Middle (11-40)        15          4.94           0.167 
#> 6 Pakistan     Death (41+)           12          5.89           0.443 

# Over by over instead of by phase
head(phase_summary(aus_pak_overs, by = "over"))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   batting_team  over matches runs_per_over wickets_per_over
#>   <chr>        <dbl>   <int>         <dbl>            <dbl>
#> 1 Australia        1      31          4.06           0.194 
#> 2 Australia        2      31          4.52           0.0645
#> 3 Australia        3      31          4.58           0.0645
#> 4 Australia        4      31          5.26           0.0323
#> 5 Australia        5      31          5.58           0.129 
#> 6 Australia        6      31          5.97           0.129
